# YouTube Comments Scraper

The Apify actor [`streamers/youtube-comments-scraper`](https://apify.com/streamers/youtube-comments-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.255**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

This alternative YouTube Data API has no limits or quotas. Extract YouTube comments data from one or multiple YouTube videos: full comment text, posting date, author username, video title, videoId. Download YouTube comments in JSON, CSV, and Excel.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Comment $0.002 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/streamers/youtube-comments-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/streamers-youtube-comments-scraper@0.0.255#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      startUrls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Output

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `author` | string \| null | The username/display name of the comment author |
| `comment` | string \| null | The text content of the comment |
| `cid` | string \| null | The unique comment ID assigned by YouTube |
| `replyCount` | number \| null | The number of replies to this comment |
| `replyToCid` | string \| null | The comment ID this comment is replying to, null if it's a top-level comment |
| `voteCount` | number \| null | The number of likes/upvotes the comment has received |
| `authorIsChannelOwner` | boolean \| null | Whether the comment author is the owner of the video's channel |
| `publishedTimeText` | string \| null | The relative time text when the comment was published (e.g., '2 days ago', '1 week ago') |
| `type` | string \| null | The type of comment - either a top-level 'comment' or a 'reply' to another comment |
| `hasCreatorHeart` | boolean \| null | Whether the video creator has 'hearted' this comment |
| `videoId` | string \| null | The unique YouTube video ID that this comment belongs to |
| `pageUrl` | string \| null | The full URL of the YouTube video page |
| `commentsCount` | number \| null | The total number of comments on the video |
| `title` | string \| null | The title of the YouTube video |
